sources.title: EPI constructed-facility recertification for Sify Rabale Tower 4
sources.date_semantics: The EPI directory gives the issue date and TIA gives the award date. The signed certificate attests to constructed condition by that date. The timing of the inspection, original completion and customer service are distinct matters.
sources.summary: On September 20, 2026, EPI recertified Rabale Tower 4 as a constructed facility. Its initial certification dates to September 2023.

constructed_facility_award.certified_scope: Sify Infinit Spaces Limited, Rabale Data Center T4
constructed_facility_award.assessment_review: EPI issued a new three-year constructed-facility award following independent assessment of the named physical facility. Its scheme distinguishes the three-year renewal from annual surveillance. The signed certificate and TIA award entry identify the same certificate number and date.
constructed_facility_award.identity_review: The award identifies Sify Infinit Spaces Limited’s Rabale Data Center T4 in the TTC Industrial Area, Navi Mumbai. Sify’s prospectus identifies Tower 4 as a separate building on its Rabale campus.
